title: READING THE ROOM: FOUNDATIONS, DESIGN, AND CHALLENGES OF NORMATIVE COMPETENCE IN LLMS
reasoning: The paper investigates the acquisition of norms by LLMs, but explicitly uses 'silly norms' (arbitrary formatting and stylistic rules such as pseudoword insertions or adding specific emojis) rather than moral, ethical, or religious norms, in order to isolate the learning signal from pre-trained knowledge.
